source.checkout_path_status: source-audit cache only; native and Runtime smoke evidence use an explicit clean detached checkout

python_environment.credential_policy: No user-supplied provider key is accepted by the Platform. The upstream Anthropic analyst path is source-audited but not used in the deterministic GP/EI parity path. Any model-substituted policy must be labeled as an adaptation, not an exact upstream-model reproduction.

physical_design_toolchain.current_status: not-paper-identical; the checkout has pre-existing local changes and generated design directories, so it may run an adapted platform campaign but may not support an exact upstream-paper PPA claim

reproduction_boundary.platform_runtime_loop: eligible after repeated feasible baseline, warm-up, GP/EI candidates, and independent confirmation
reproduction_boundary.upstream_full_launcher: blocked: its scripts assume named SSH hosts, remote paths, and an Anthropic credentialed analyst
reproduction_boundary.paper_published_numbers: not comparable until the paper ORFS commit, exact design/PDK assets, toolchain, and full protocol are separately admitted

security_entrypoint_review.run_or_job.py: DENY: invokes SSH and eval(stdout.strip()); never executed by the platform adapter.
security_entrypoint_review.maindriver.sh: DENY: mutates shared Makefiles and assumes named remote hosts; never executed.
security_entrypoint_review.run_agent.sh: DENY: writes .env and creates a virtual environment; never executed.
security_entrypoint_review.analyst_agent_workbench.py: ALLOW, bounded: imported only from an explicit clean checkout in the isolated ORFS-Agent venv; native GP/EI call receives local data only, no network or credential.

change_rule: Any source, dependency, or toolchain change creates a new lock file and a new campaign fingerprint; it never rewrites this lock or an existing campaign.
